prompts.prompt: Photorealistic dramatic editorial photo: a gleaming silicon semiconductor wafer close-up on a dark trading desk, reflecting a large red falling stock chart line from monitors behind it, moody dark blue and red lighting, tense atmosphere, shallow depth of field. Keep the bottom 30% darker and simple for captions. No text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
